title: Maciej Ceglowski - The Website Obesity Crisis [Web Directions 2015 Keynote]
summary: Maciej Ceglowski's Web Directions 2015 keynote on website bloat, arguing that pages have grown far heavier than their content justifies. This is a re-upload of the original talk.
